name: snailracer
description: Demo de apuestas en carreras de caracoles con pasarela de pagos simulada (SnailPay).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @snailracer/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @snailracer/shared" "npm run dev -w @snailracer/api" "npm run dev -w @snailracer/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @snailracer/shared && npm run build -w @snailracer/api && npm run build -w @snailracer/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @snailracer/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @snailracer/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
